---
name: Release checklist
about: What a release waits for that only hardware and a person can check (roadmap M8.7)
labels: release
---

The release workflow opens this issue for each tag, the draft release holds the preset pictures and `defaults.diff`, and the stable channel moves only once every box is ticked.

## On the reference laptop

- [ ] Wi-Fi connects
- [ ] Bluetooth audio plays
- [ ] Sleep and wake
- [ ] An external display
- [ ] The camera
- [ ] Printing
- [ ] The battery's charge and time left
- [ ] A game controller

## Defaults reviewed

- [ ] Defaults reviewed: the preset pictures and defaults.diff attached to the draft release look right
